    'supervisor_decision': 'schemas/project_control_plane/supervisor_decision.schema.json',
}
for key, schema_path in contract_map.items():
    Draft202012Validator(schemas[schema_path]).validate(e2e['contract_instances'][key])
print(f'e2e_contract_instances_ok={len(contract_map)}')
